preconditions.description: The size of arrays a and b is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in array a is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in array b is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(sum(abs(a[i] - b[j]) for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible value of the sum of absolute differences after at most one swap in array b.
